instruction: My husband has asked me what I'd like for dinner on phone. Reply him with any one of my favorite recipes' name from my Simple Note account. Just the name, nothing else.
notes: Two apps (phone, simple_note) plus supervisor. Husband's phone number is discovered via phone.search_contacts(relationship=husband); phone.search_text_messages confirms his dinner question (modeled as dinner-request-found, required before replying). The favorite recipes note is found by simple_note.search_notes and its content read by simple_note.show_note, which yields one recipe name (object favorite-recipe). phone.send_text_message sends exactly that name as the message, producing (replied-with-recipe husband favorite-recipe), the only DB change the evaluation demands. supervisor.complete_task takes no API answer (not a question); its person/recipe parameters are task-record parameters only, used so its precondition equals the goal condition. (task-completed) blocks all other actions, guaranteeing it is last.
